name: Molecule
definition: A distinct chemical molecule in the toxicology dataset, identified by a molecule identifier of the form TRxxx. A molecule owns its atoms and bonds, and carcinogenicity is recorded per molecule.
scope: Toxicology structural dataset; 444 molecules have atom/bond structure and 343 of them have a carcinogenicity label.

name: Atom
definition: A single atom belonging to exactly one molecule. Its identifier is the molecule identifier followed by '_' and the atom ordinal within that molecule, for example TR004_8 is atom 8 of molecule TR004.
scope: One row in the atom table per atom; 12,333 atoms across 444 molecules.

name: Bond
definition: A chemical bond between two atoms of the same molecule. Its identifier is the molecule identifier followed by the ordinals of the two endpoint atoms, for example TR004_8_9 is the bond between atoms 8 and 9 of molecule TR004.
scope: One row in the bond table per bond; 12,379 bonds across 444 molecules.

name: Atom-Bond Incidence
definition: The participation of one atom in one bond. Each incidence row records an atom, the other atom of the same bond, and the bond identifier. Every bond is stored twice, once from each endpoint.
scope: Connectivity relation with 24,758 rows covering all 12,379 bonds and all bonded atoms.

name: Chemical Element
definition: The chemical element of an atom, recorded as a lowercase chemical symbol such as c for carbon, h for hydrogen, or cl for chlorine.
scope: Atom-level attribute; 21 distinct element symbols across 12,333 atoms.

name: Carbon
definition: The chemical element carbon, represented by the lowercase atom element symbol 'c'.
scope: Subset of atoms whose element symbol is 'c' (4,605 atoms).

name: Bond Order
definition: The order or type of a chemical bond: single, double, or triple, encoded as '-', '=', or '#' respectively. Also called bond type.
scope: Bond-level attribute; one bond has an unknown order.

name: Single Bond
definition: A bond of order one, encoded as '-'.
scope: Subset of bonds with bond order '-' (10,528 bonds).

name: Double Bond
definition: A bond of order two, encoded as '='.
scope: Subset of bonds with bond order '=' (1,844 bonds).

name: Triple Bond
definition: A bond of order three, encoded as '#'.
scope: Subset of bonds with bond order '#' (6 bonds across 4 molecules).

name: Carcinogenicity Label
definition: The carcinogenicity classification of a molecule: '+' means carcinogenic and '-' means non-carcinogenic.
scope: Molecule-level attribute available for 343 of the 444 molecules.

name: Atom Ordinal
definition: The position of an atom within its molecule, encoded as the numeric suffix of the atom identifier. Ordinals start at 1 and are contiguous up to the molecule's atom count; they may have one, two, or three digits.
scope: Derived from the atom identifier suffix; observed molecule sizes range from 4 to 174 atoms.

name: Connection Count
definition: The number of distinct bonds incident to an atom, i.e., how many connections the atom has.
scope: Computed per atom from atom-bond incidence; independent of incidence row direction.

name: Molecule Atom Count
definition: The number of atoms belonging to a molecule.
scope: Computed per molecule from the atom table; observed range 4 to 174 atoms.

name: Molecule Bond Count
definition: The number of bonds belonging to a molecule.
scope: Computed per molecule from the bond table; observed range 2 to 175 bonds.

name: Bond Type Count
definition: The number of bonds of a specified bond order within a molecule or molecule population.
scope: Computed by grouping bonds by bond order; supports majority-bond-type and bond-percentage questions.

name: Bond Type Share
definition: The share of bonds of a specified bond order among the bonds of a molecule or molecule population, usually expressed as a percentage.
scope: Computed as the count of bonds of the selected order divided by the total bond count of the population.

name: Element Share
definition: The share of atoms of a specified element among the atoms of a molecule or molecule population, usually expressed as a percentage.
scope: Computed as the count of atoms of the selected element divided by the total atom count of the population.

name: Dominant Bond Order
definition: The bond order with the highest bond count in a molecule, used to express the bond type that accounts for the majority of the molecule's bonds.
scope: Computed per molecule from bond type counts.

name: Unconnected Atom
definition: An atom that participates in no bond, i.e., an atom with no atom-bond incidence record.
scope: Atoms present in the atom table but absent from the connectivity relation; 49 atoms.
aliases: atom cannot bond with any other atoms
